face.name: 受伤的克瓦迪尔
face.flavorText: 不用担心。只要擦点护肤霜，他又会焕然一新的。

face.name: Injured Kvaldir
face.flavorText: Don't worry. With a little skin cream he's going to clear right up.

face.name: 孵化池觅食者
face.flavorText: 做好这份工作，需要耐心，热情，还有最高级的鱼人觅食手套。

face.name: Spawnpool Forager
face.flavorText: Putting food on the table requires persistence, enthusiasm, and the finest murloc Gloves of Foraging.

face.name: 机械袋鼠
face.text: 亡语：召唤一个1/1的机械袋鼠宝宝。
face.flavorText: 她的宝宝有两个亲密玩伴，一个是机械小熊，一个是机械小虎。

face.name: Mecharoo
face.flavorText: Its project name was KAN-GA. The little one was R-00.

face.name: 晶化师
face.text: 战吼：对你的英雄造成5点伤害。获得5点护甲值。

face.name: Crystallizer
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage to your hero. Gain 5 Armor.
face.flavorText: This elf's winning the arms race.

face.name: 乌祖尔恐魔
face.text: 亡语：将一张2/1的“迷失之魂”置入你的 手牌。
face.flavorText: 面面面面面对加拉克苏斯！

face.name: Ur'zul Horror
face.text: Deathrattle: Add a 2/1 Lost Soul to your hand.
face.flavorText: You face face face face face Jaraxxus!

face.name: 狗头人图书管理员
face.text: 战吼： 抽一张牌。对你的英雄造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 狗头人用蜡油十进制法来分类图书。

face.name: Kobold Librarian
face.text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Deal 2 damage to your hero.
face.flavorText: Kobolds sort books using a gooey decimal system.

face.name: 炽炎蝙蝠
face.text: 亡语：随机对一个敌人造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 多亏了防火型护发素，炽炎蝙蝠才活到今天。

face.name: Fiery Bat
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.

face.name: 翡翠掠夺者
face.text: 战吼：对每个英雄造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 他想去加基森干一番事业，玉莲帮会是不错的选择。

face.name: Emerald Reaver
face.flavorText: Not to be confused with clubbing enthusiast Emerald Raver.

face.name: 麻风侏儒
face.text: 亡语：对敌方英雄造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 他真的很想和你做朋友，但由于总是被排斥，他开始变得很沮丧。

face.name: Leper Gnome
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: He really just wants to be your friend, but the constant rejection is starting to really get to him.

policies.source: 12 complete fixed original rows,24 strict bilingual primary faces,6 explicit API child edges plus3 distinct raw collection tag edges retained. No normalization. manifest01 was original grouping-only error and is not executed or used as active scope.
policies.execution: All damage/heal/armor/draw/death/entry/creation/overflow/RNG/choice timing delegated to existing engine. Battlecry self damage is not spell damage; fixed hero group uses one DamageBatch. Original Deathrattle controller and original death position/cause determine child delivery.
policies.pools: No production past pool or inferred/pruned inventory; only explicit complete bounded experimental host pools in tests. Qualifying unknown definitions fail before RNG, not cropped.
policies.limits: Internal behavior and proof only; formal pool/CN/full reachability remain open. No public kernel/central assembly/old definitions/versions/ledgers changed.
